style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: square food illustration for a Belarusian meal planner. Traditional hand-painted watercolor on warm cream paper (#faf8f5), delicate irregular edges, translucent washes, visible subtle paper grain, natural muted food colors. Direct overhead view, centered complete subject occupying 75% of frame with generous empty margins. No words, lettering, logos or watermark. No photorealism, no 3D, no collage. One coherent square illustration. Subject:

subjects.oatmeal: a ceramic bowl of oatmeal with banana slices, blueberries, raspberries, chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey
subjects.omelet: A fluffy golden omelet with spinach leaves and grated cheese on a ceramic plate.
subjects.casserole: A golden baked cottage cheese casserole slice with sour cream and honey on a ceramic plate.
subjects.avocado-toast: Two whole grain toast slices topped with sliced avocado and poached eggs on a ceramic plate.
subjects.shakshuka: A small terracotta pan of shakshuka: eggs with visible yolks nestled in rich tomato and red pepper sauce, with herbs and bread beside it.
subjects.syrniki: Four small thick golden cottage cheese pancakes (syrniki), sour cream and berries on a ceramic plate.
subjects.fish-potatoes: A ceramic plate of baked white fish fillet, roasted potato wedges, lemon and dill.
subjects.mushroom-buckwheat: A ceramic bowl of brown buckwheat with sauteed sliced mushrooms, onions and parsley.
subjects.turkey-bulgur: A ceramic plate of turkey breast pieces with golden bulgur, diced red pepper and herbs.
subjects.tuna-salad: A ceramic bowl of tuna salad with leafy greens, tomato wedges, cucumber slices and egg halves.
subjects.restaurant: An elegant restaurant place setting: empty cream ceramic plate, neatly folded linen napkin, fork and knife, water glass and small vase with one flower. No food.
subjects.delivery: A brown paper food delivery bag beside two kraft takeaway food containers, one open showing a colorful meal. No branding or words.
subjects.chicken-barley: Sliced roasted chicken breast with cooked pearl barley (distinct plump beige oval grains, NOT rice) and broccoli.
subjects.buckwheat-salmon: Cooked brown buckwheat groats beside delicate folded slices of lightly salted salmon, a generous dollop of white Philadelphia cream cheese, and dill. No eggs.
subjects.salmon-crepes: Thin savory crepes rolled around lightly salted salmon, fresh cucumber batons and white Philadelphia cream cheese, cut diagonally to reveal the filling. Dill garnish. No berries, no fruit, no cottage cheese.
subjects.shrimp-pasta: Pasta with pink cooked shrimp and halved red cherry tomatoes in a light olive oil sauce, parsley and garlic. No zucchini.
subjects.lentils-turkey: Hearty red lentils with clearly visible cooked turkey breast pieces, carrots, tomatoes, onion and parsley.
subjects.beef-tartare: Classic finely hand-chopped raw beef tartare formed into a small neat round mound, with capers, finely chopped shallot and pickled cucumber, Dijon mustard, parsley, and two crisp toast slices beside it. No egg. Elegant appetizing culinary watercolor.
